title: Clock and Number Fun
subject: math
instructions: Write your number in the boxes. Show your thinking.

questions.prompt: What time does the clock show?

diagram.description: A clock face with the hour hand just past 3 and the minute hand on the 6 (3:30). One answer box to its right.

questions.prompt: Mia has 34 stickers. She gets 25 more. How many stickers does she have now?
questions.key: Adds 34 + 25: tens (30 + 20 = 50) and ones (4 + 5 = 9), or counts on, or a drawing of tens and ones that shows 59.

questions.prompt: Start at 20. Draw jumps of 5 to get to 35.

diagram.description: A number line from 20 to 40 with a tick at every whole number and labels every 5.

checklist.item: There are three jumps, each 5 long (20 to 25, 25 to 30, 30 to 35).
